known_facts_at_decision_date: Future Retail was financially distressed with substantial debt obligations as of April 2022
Future Group had agreed to sell retail assets to Reliance Industries but the transaction became entangled in Amazon-related legal disputes
Future Retail had warned in 2020 that if the Reliance deal failed, liquidation risk existed
Bank of India filed insolvency proceedings against Future Retail for non-payment of dues
Future Retail owed banks ₹5,322.32 crore as of 31 March 2022 per Bank of India NCLT petition
Bank of India filed a petition under IBC before NCLT
Proposed Reliance transaction could not be implemented after secured creditors voted against the scheme
Business situation combined debt pressure, legal and regulatory uncertainty, creditor resistance, liquidity stress, and failed strategic rescue

financial_signals_at_decision_date.reliance_deal_status: Blocked by legal dispute and creditor vote

governance_signals_at_decision_date.legal_dispute: Amazon arbitration dispute entangling asset sale

risk_flags_at_decision_date: IBC petition filed by major creditor — formal insolvency imminent if not resolved
No viable alternative strategic buyer identified
Secured creditors already voted against rescue scheme
Amazon dispute blocking only strategic exit
Liquidity insufficient to service debt obligations
No evidence of alternative restructuring plan
question: Given debt pressure, failed and blocked Reliance transaction, creditor resistance, Amazon legal dispute, and active insolvency petition, diagnose root causes and recommend the highest-priority action plan to maximize recovery and preserve business value.
